_comment: Discord bitwise permission flags. Values are derived as (1 << bit).
notes: Bit 47 is not assigned in the official table and is intentionally absent.
requires_2fa marks permissions that require the owner account to use 2FA on guilds with server-wide 2FA enabled (footnote '*' in the official table).
channel_types uses the official abbreviations: T=Text, V=Voice, S=Stage. An empty list means the permission is not channel-scoped.

permissions.name: CREATE_INSTANT_INVITE
permissions.description: Allows creation of instant invites

permissions.name: KICK_MEMBERS
permissions.description: Allows kicking members

permissions.name: BAN_MEMBERS
permissions.description: Allows banning members

permissions.name: ADMINISTRATOR
permissions.description: Allows all permissions and bypasses channel permission overwrites

permissions.name: MANAGE_CHANNELS
permissions.description: Allows management and editing of channels

permissions.name: MANAGE_GUILD
permissions.description: Allows management and editing of the guild

permissions.name: ADD_REACTIONS
permissions.description: Allows for adding new reactions to messages. This permission does not apply to reacting with an existing reaction on a message.

permissions.name: VIEW_AUDIT_LOG
permissions.description: Allows for viewing of audit logs

permissions.name: PRIORITY_SPEAKER
permissions.description: Allows for using priority speaker in a voice channel

permissions.name: STREAM
permissions.description: Allows the user to go live

permissions.name: VIEW_CHANNEL
permissions.description: Allows guild members to view a channel, which includes reading messages in text channels and joining voice channels

permissions.name: SEND_MESSAGES
permissions.description: Allows for sending messages in a channel and creating threads in a forum (does not allow sending messages in threads)

permissions.name: SEND_TTS_MESSAGES
permissions.description: Allows for sending of `/tts` messages

permissions.name: MANAGE_MESSAGES
permissions.description: Allows for deletion of other users messages

permissions.name: EMBED_LINKS
permissions.description: Links sent by users with this permission will be auto-embedded

permissions.name: ATTACH_FILES
permissions.description: Allows for uploading images and files

permissions.name: READ_MESSAGE_HISTORY
permissions.description: Allows for reading of message history

permissions.name: MENTION_EVERYONE
permissions.description: Allows for using the `@everyone` tag to notify all users in a channel, and the `@here` tag to notify all online users in a channel

permissions.name: USE_EXTERNAL_EMOJIS
permissions.description: Allows the usage of custom emojis from other servers

permissions.name: VIEW_GUILD_INSIGHTS
permissions.description: Allows for viewing guild insights

permissions.name: CONNECT
permissions.description: Allows for joining of a voice channel

permissions.name: SPEAK
permissions.description: Allows for speaking in a voice channel

permissions.name: MUTE_MEMBERS
permissions.description: Allows for muting members in a voice channel

permissions.name: DEAFEN_MEMBERS
permissions.description: Allows for deafening of members in a voice channel

permissions.name: MOVE_MEMBERS
permissions.description: Allows for moving of members between voice channels

permissions.name: USE_VAD
permissions.description: Allows for using voice-activity-detection in a voice channel

permissions.name: CHANGE_NICKNAME
permissions.description: Allows for modification of own nickname

permissions.name: MANAGE_NICKNAMES
permissions.description: Allows for modification of other users nicknames

permissions.name: MANAGE_ROLES
permissions.description: Allows management and editing of roles

permissions.name: MANAGE_WEBHOOKS
permissions.description: Allows management and editing of webhooks

permissions.name: MANAGE_GUILD_EXPRESSIONS
permissions.description: Allows for editing and deleting emojis, stickers, and soundboard sounds created by all users

permissions.name: USE_APPLICATION_COMMANDS
permissions.description: Allows members to use application commands, including slash commands and context menu commands.

permissions.name: REQUEST_TO_SPEAK
permissions.description: Allows for requesting to speak in stage channels

permissions.name: MANAGE_EVENTS
permissions.description: Allows for editing and deleting scheduled events created by all users

permissions.name: MANAGE_THREADS
permissions.description: Allows for deleting and archiving threads, and viewing all private threads

permissions.name: CREATE_PUBLIC_THREADS
permissions.description: Allows for creating public and announcement threads

permissions.name: CREATE_PRIVATE_THREADS
permissions.description: Allows for creating private threads

permissions.name: USE_EXTERNAL_STICKERS
permissions.description: Allows the usage of custom stickers from other servers

permissions.name: SEND_MESSAGES_IN_THREADS
permissions.description: Allows for sending messages in threads

permissions.name: USE_EMBEDDED_ACTIVITIES
permissions.description: Allows for using Activities (applications with the `EMBEDDED` flag)

permissions.name: MODERATE_MEMBERS
permissions.description: Allows for timing out users to prevent them from sending or reacting to messages in chat and threads, and from speaking in voice and stage channels

permissions.name: VIEW_CREATOR_MONETIZATION_ANALYTICS
permissions.description: Allows for viewing role subscription insights

permissions.name: USE_SOUNDBOARD
permissions.description: Allows for using soundboard in a voice channel

permissions.name: CREATE_GUILD_EXPRESSIONS
permissions.description: Allows for creating emojis, stickers, and soundboard sounds, and editing and deleting those created by the current user.

permissions.name: CREATE_EVENTS
permissions.description: Allows for creating scheduled events, and editing and deleting those created by the current user.

permissions.name: USE_EXTERNAL_SOUNDS
permissions.description: Allows the usage of custom soundboard sounds from other servers

permissions.name: SEND_VOICE_MESSAGES
permissions.description: Allows sending voice messages

permissions.name: SET_VOICE_CHANNEL_STATUS
permissions.description: Allows setting voice channel status

permissions.name: SEND_POLLS
permissions.description: Allows sending polls

permissions.name: USE_EXTERNAL_APPS
permissions.description: Allows user-installed apps to send public responses. When disabled, users will still be allowed to use their apps but the responses will be ephemeral. This only applies to apps not also installed to the server.

permissions.name: PIN_MESSAGES
permissions.description: Allows pinning and unpinning messages

permissions.name: BYPASS_SLOWMODE
permissions.description: Allows bypassing slowmode restrictions
